name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: Keep Codex development tasks resumable, verifiable, and aligned across one to eight local Git repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex tasks resumable and verifiable
interface.longDescription: Dev Flow Orchestrator 0.2.0 keeps long-running Codex development resumable and aligned with explicit acceptance criteria across an exact set of one to eight user-prepared Git worktrees. Resume the same task in a new session and finish with evidence that shows what passed, what remains, and why. The dev-flow-workflow/0.2.0 controller exposes one current action to one Codex, binds dev-flow-agent/0.2.0 evidence to aggregate repository-set snapshots and repository-scoped resources, requires structured member/integration verification, and finishes every non-cancelled path with a dev-flow-delivery-dossier/0.2.0. State stays local and outside target repositories. Dev Flow never manages worktrees or branches, publishes Git changes, starts parallel agents, or dispatches external CI, PR, or release automation.
defaultPrompt: Start a resumable Dev Flow task for this requirement and its prepared repositories.
Resume my active Dev Flow task and continue from its authoritative next action.
Verify this task against its acceptance criteria and generate the Delivery Dossier.
